purpose: Falsify Utopia runtime claims with uncomfortable app shapes. These are tests, not feature promises.

entries.title: Metronome with polyrhythms

entries.currentEvidence: Adversarial JSON fixture exists at tests/fixtures/adversarial-apps/metronome-polyrhythms/metronome-polyrhythms.v1.json; timingLoop remains the missing primitive.
